verse.verse_2: who, when people measure for them, take full measure,
verse.verse_3: but when they measure or weigh for others, they reduce!
verse.verse_4: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verse.verse_6: the Day when people will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
verse.verse_7: No indeed, the Book of the immoral is in Sijjeen.
verse.verse_8: What could let you know what the Sijjeen is!
verse.verse_10: Woe on that Day to those who belied it,
verse.verse_11: who belied the Day of Recompense!
verse.verse_12: None belies it except every guilty sinner.
verse.verse_13: When Our verses are recited to him, he says: 'Fictitious tales of the ancients'
verse.verse_14: No indeed! Their own deeds have cast a veil over their hearts.
verse.verse_15: No indeed, on that Day they shall be veiled from their Lord.
verse.verse_16: Then they shall roast in Hell,
verse.verse_17: and it will be said to them: 'This is that which you belied'
verse.verse_18: But, the Book of the righteous is in the 'Illiyoon.
verse.verse_19: What could let you know what the 'Illiyoon is!
verse.verse_21: witnessed by those who are near (to Allah).
verse.verse_22: The righteous shall indeed be blissful,
verse.verse_24: and in their faces you shall know the radiance of bliss.
verse.verse_25: They shall be given to drink of a wine that is sealed,
verse.verse_26: its seal is musk, for this let the competitors compete;
verse.verse_28: a fountain at which those brought near (to their Lord) drink.
verse.verse_29: The sinners laughed at the believers
verse.verse_30: and winked at one another as they passed them by.
verse.verse_31: When they returned to their people they returned jesting;
verse.verse_32: and when they saw them said: 'These are they who are astray'
verse.verse_33: Yet they were not sent to be their guardians.
verse.verse_34: But on this Day the believers will laugh at the unbelievers
verse.verse_35: as they (recline) upon their couches and gaze (around them).
verse.verse_36: Have the unbelievers been rewarded for what they did?
